entries.speaker: Palace Maker
entries.en: After you have [clr 2]purchased items[clr 27] with P Medals, you[n]will be able to place them within the Thieves Den.

entries.speaker: Palace Maker
entries.en: [clr 2]Cognitive allies and confidants[clr 27] will come to view and[n][clr 2]discuss your items[clr 27]. These characters will change when you[n]enter the Thieves Den or change the item's location.

entries.speaker: Palace Maker
entries.en: You can adjust these [clr 2]decorations[clr 27] based on your story[n]progress. The interior of the Thieves Den may even[n]change depending on your décor.
